title: DeLonge in secure facilities
summary: Tom DeLonge tells of DeLonge in secure facilities, about 2010s at secure facilities (unspecified), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I have been in secure facilities, you know, the codes and the alarms and the guns and all that shit to get into there and they lock you in and they're airtight

plain: The musician Tom DeLonge says that sometime in the 2010s he was taken inside secure government-style facilities, the kind with codes, alarms and armed guards at the door, where you are locked in and the rooms are airtight. He tells this himself on Jesse Michels's show, as something he went through firsthand. He brings it up to show how far inside the world of secrets he says he has been.
